summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for membership external import and annual report enhancements using public URL. Core XLSX/DOCX import, annual report, search visibility, and organization isolation passed. Two issues remain: auth preflight CORS mismatch and unclear PDF import behavior when text extraction yields no rows.

critical.issue: Public preflight still returns access-control-allow-origin='*' instead of explicit origin, despite credentialed auth flow expectations.

minor.issue: For some text-PDF payloads where parser extracts zero rows, API responds 200 with imported_count=0 and skipped_count=0 (no explicit rejection reason), which conflicts with clear-rejection expectation.

issues: Birth date still uses browser native date input picker instead of app-consistent calendar component.

action_items: Fix edge/ingress CORS for auth preflight to return explicit allowed origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true.
In /api/memberships/import, when extracted rows are zero for provided PDF, return clear actionable rejection detail instead of silent 0/0 success.
Optionally standardize membership birth-date input with project-wide calendar component.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is a large monolith (~4900 LOC), increasing regression risk; split membership/import/auth concerns into focused modules.
Seed-admin logic appears idempotent in code path: existing admin password hash is re-generated when ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD changes (lines around ensure_default_admin).
bcrypt hashing is actively used via hash_password/verify_password code paths.
Electronic invoice tax authority flow remains MOCKED/internal from prior scope and was not part of this membership test run.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Used social-solidarity: admin_takaful/Admin@123 (fallback admin/Admin@123), and general-union: admin_union/Admin@123.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary membership rows with TEST_IT26_/IT26_ prefixes (auto-cleanup in pytest teardown where DB env available). UI flow also inserted UI_IT26_MEMBER_* via import and remains because no membership delete endpoint is exposed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: 10 total, 8 passed, 2 failed (CORS preflight + PDF clear-rejection behavior). UI automation passed social import/search/report and general-union membership blocking checks end-to-end.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (CORS): Backend has explicit CORS/preflight middleware for credentialed origins, but public OPTIONS still returns wildcard '*', indicating edge/proxy header override before browser receives response. RCA-2 (PDF): Import pipeline depends on text extraction rows. If extraction returns no lines, endpoint currently returns success with zero detected/skipped rows, giving no explicit user-facing reason. Mitigation: treat empty extraction as explicit validation failure or populate skipped_rows with reason.
